rows: Running as root is forbidden. Replace with a non-root user.
No `USER` line at all, OR final `USER` line argument is `root`/`0`
Container must declare a non-root `USER` instruction.

Any `ENV` or `ARG` line matches `(?i)(PASSWORD\|PASSWD\|SECRET\|TOKEN\|API[_-]?KEY\|PRIVATE[_-]?KEY\|ACCESS[_-]?KEY\|CREDENTIAL\|DATABASE_URL\|CONNECTION_STRING\|REDIS_URL\|MONGODB?_URI\|_DSN)\b.*=\s*\S+` with a non-empty, non-placeholder value
Hardcoded secret in `ENV`/`ARG`. Inject via runtime (Kubernetes Secret).
Same as above but covers `RUN export FOO=…` and `RUN echo "FOO=…"` shapes
Drop `sudo`; run the entire stage as the required user instead.
`RUN` line with `apt-get install` but NO `rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*` in the same `RUN`
Combine update + install + cleanup in one `RUN`.
Combine `RUN` instructions with `&&` to reduce layers.
`COPY . .` (or `COPY . /<dir>`) appears **before** any `COPY package*.json` / `COPY pom.xml` / `COPY go.mod` / `COPY requirements*.txt` / `COPY Cargo.toml`
Copy dependency manifests before source for better layer caching.
Single `FROM` AND any of `mvn`, `gradle`, `npm run build`, `go build`, `cargo build`, `dotnet publish` appears in a `RUN` line
Use multi-stage build to drop build tools from the final image.
Any `FROM` whose tag is `latest` or missing (no `:`)
Pin a specific major version tag, never `:latest`.
Add `HEALTHCHECK` (or note why if image is distroless / shell-less).
No `WORKDIR` line, OR any `RUN cd /` pattern
Application code references a port (`PORT=`, `LISTEN`, `:8080`, `:3000`, `:5000`) but no `EXPOSE` line
Add the attribution `createdby` label (and `version` if a version is available) for traceability.
